definition.definition: Q_d is the nonnegative quantity explicitly attributed to direction d during a fixed observation window. BUY and SELL series are separate; neither candle colour nor total volume assigns direction.
definition.signConvention: Direction label d; signed percentage changes and signed ratio retained separately from absolute E_d.
